[LIMP.8.2.1] Skew between an adapter binary and the `.ds`
library it ships with surfaces at runtime through name-
match checks. When the integrator registers a callback
against libds for a service name the loaded DSC does not
declare, libds rejects the registration. When the DSC
declares a service for which no callback is registered at
engine-ready, libds rejects the engine-ready transition.
